name: rename-review-local-receipt-identifiers
title: Rename the internal sd-review-local-stage and sd-review-local-policy identifiers
description: The sd-review-local command surface was retired in pack 0.65.0, but the successor coordinator still carries sd-review-local-stage and sd-review-local-policy as internal receipt identifiers. Rename them to match the surviving sd-review vocabulary. This is a receipt-schema change: it moves values that appear in persisted review receipts, so it needs a schema-version decision and consumer-side compatibility handling, which is why it was deferred out of 07-24-remove-retired-review-surfaces.
creator: sdelmas
